### Changed

- *(migration)* Run agent-manager 2.5.0 for the tenant pass in [#1104](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1104) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- Align files according to platform standards in [#1112](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1112) by [@giantswarm-align-files[bot]](https://github.com/giantswarm-align-files[bot])

### Fixed

- *(connectivity)* Delete the orphaned workspace-manager sign-in keys Secret on upgrade in [#1099](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1099) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(components)* Cap every component range at the line its values were proven against in [#1100](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1100) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(components)* Select kagent 1.15, the workspace write path in [#1110](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1110) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(connectivity)* The config-reload stamp carries its own field manager in [#1101](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1101) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(muster)* Do not wait for muster's pods until Substrate is Ready in [#1109](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1109) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
